description: Allow the gateway web UI (served from localhost into the webview) to report that it has mounted (the shell shows the window then), set its own zoom level (the interface-scale setting), open the system file picker an agent's directory/file config field uses to bind a host mount, choose the voice output: list the PipeWire sinks and route lmgw's own playback streams to one (chat-voice §12.3), and start the machine check's fix, which the shell confirms in its own dialog before the password prompt (machine-check §4.3). While the shell draws the window frame itself (the default on Linux; LMGW_WINDOW=kwin turns it off, src-tauri/src/window_chrome.rs) the page drives its window controls: minimize, maximize, close, the header's drag and window menu; with KWin's frame that command refuses all but the state.
